resenas.texto: Excellent place, very picturesque and full of artisans. Totally recommended.
A beautiful place I always come back to for its landscapes and the quality of its people.
The square is very well designed; the streetlamps, the fairs and the shops around it make it very pleasant.
A very colonial, well-kept square with artisans. A good place to rest, relax and enjoy Cafayate.
A beautiful place, Cafayate. The warmth of its people is lovely; one excursion is not enough, you need more time to explore it.
Beautiful.
A lovely place to visit.
Nice.
A good place to rest in Cachi, with crafts nearby, the old church and the anthropological museum.
Lovely square in the center of Cachi.
A beautiful area of about 70 km, surrounded by colors and incredible landscapes. If you go from Salta to Cafayate, you should drive it slowly and keep stopping.
A spectacular, ever-changing landscape, with iconic formations like the Amphitheater and the Devil's Throat.
A must-stop among the great landscapes of our country. Everywhere you look there is something beautiful.
Driving this road is incredible. The colors, the formations and the landscapes make you want to stop constantly.
A beautiful drive. The Devil's Throat is the best, followed by the Amphitheater.
Very good, with a spectacular view. On the way back they change sides so you can enjoy both landscapes, and the guides help you take photos at the viaduct.
I loved it, the view is spectacular. The ride lasts about three hours and the seats are comfortable.
Charming and beautiful; a place to return to without a doubt.
The bus and the service were excellent, with breakfast, afternoon snack and staff assistance throughout the trip. I recommend the excursion, which takes almost the whole day.
The excursion was excellent, very well organized, with a bus in good condition, guide, nurse, breakfast and afternoon snack. The experience is worth it.
A place that stays in time, with a fair to browse, shop or have lunch. The walk to the Hill of Seven Colors viewpoint is short and easy.
Beautiful place. I recommend going in to see the Hill of Seven Colors, browsing the square's fairs and trying the stuffed tortillas.
A beautiful village at the foot of the Hill of Seven Colors, full of bars and inns, with its typical church, square and crafts market.
The road to Purmamarca is beautiful, beside rocky mountains in green and copper tones. I recommend waking up early to see the sunrise and the mist.
Nice!
A very beautiful place, with many nearby sites to explore and plenty of options to shop at good prices.
Tilcara is ideal as a base when visiting the Humahuaca Gorge because of its food and hotel offer and its easy access to other places along the route.
If you want to tour the north, I recommend staying in Tilcara because everything is close by and you can visit different places always returning to the village.
The whole Humahuaca Gorge is a magical place. Besides the landscapes, the food and the culture are impressive.
I loved Tilcara. It has a square, artisans, tranquility, great food, streets to walk and art everywhere.
A beautiful place to visit. You can also get there by public transport from Tilcara.
A very beautiful and charming town.
After Purmamarca, one of the loveliest towns in Jujuy. It is quick to tour and has beautiful little streets and stalls; a must-see.
Beautiful from every angle. Considering how touristy it is, it should have more investment in infrastructure.
An incredible place. The guided visit to the salt extraction areas and to the eye of the salt flat stands out for its unique beauty.
You get there along a scenic route, climbing above 4,000 meters above sea level. The guides explain the origin of the salt flat and help you take photos.
A very nice experience listening to the guide explain the place. Don't miss it, it's very beautiful.
A beautiful place. I recommend bringing cash because cell signal doesn't work well, and doing the tour with a guide to make the most of the experience.
A very nice place to take photos. I recommend bringing sunscreen and water because the sun is very intense; it's worth visiting.
Incredible views. At that altitude the weather can change very quickly.
Once you're up there, the discomforts of the journey are forgotten. It truly is an incomparable spectacle, very recommended.
An exceptional and impressive place, even better than the photographs show.
A wonderful place. I recommend visiting at sunset and walking closer to watch how the colors of the mountains change quickly.
One of the most beautiful colorful mountain landscapes I have ever seen. I recommend preparing for the altitude and bringing warm clothes.
A beautiful place to rest with the family. The weather lets you walk, run, cycle, go trekking and enjoy the river.
A charming mountain village surrounded by green valleys and imposing hills. Ideal for relaxing, enjoying nature and learning about the local culture.
Gorgeous.
A destination to rest and enjoy privileged views in both summer and winter. Its streets, the lake, the food and the cheeses stand out.
The drive is gorgeous, with jungle-like vegetation, natural waterfalls, a river and butterflies. I recommend coming back with more time to explore it better.
The place is beautiful. You can find crafts at good prices and it has a lot of history.
A beautiful place to rest and enjoy the landscapes. The Pachamama Museum is a must-see.
Don't miss this little village. It is small, welcoming and very lively.
In Amaicha del Valle there is a very interesting art gallery, with high-quality handmade products and very unique pieces.
An experience worth it. The museum, the history, the kindness of the staff and the chance to walk the ruins freely stand out.
Excellent interpretation center, spotless bathrooms and well-preserved ruins. Overall, I think the experience was very good.
A beautiful, highly recommended place. The viewpoints let you appreciate the ruins from different angles and the museum helps you understand their history.
Sublime.
A wonderful place to visit. The museum offers useful information to understand the ruins and the views are spectacular.
A beautiful place to spend time, drink mate and eat. It is incredibly beautiful.
Natural.
Gorgeous.
Gorgeous.
